summary.value: Guided walking/audio history tours here mean an unhurried walk with a volunteer New Yorker who chooses streets around your interests. It feels like time with a generous friend, it is accessible for mixed-ability groups, and you get to enjoy the Greeter’s favorite neighborhoods, restaurants, shops, and hidden places.
